description: Filter the finished SPX sessions in the FirmTape archive by their closing measurements and count them: regime at the close and at the open, zero-gamma flip crossings, whether the expected-hold band held, direction and size of the move, net-gamma percentile, 0DTE ATM IV at the open, the calendar event, weekday and year. Returns how many sessions match, three shares over them (closed above the flip, band held, mean absolute move) printed next to the same shares over the whole archive, and the matched days. A matched share close to the archive's share is a base rate, not a pattern. Use when: 'how often did FOMC days close in negative gamma', 'the days the band broke with the percentile under 20', 'largest moves on CPI days since 2024'. Not for: one day's numbers (get_session), gamma by strike (get_gex_profile), or testing a rule with out-of-sample statistics (the Lab). Limits: counts over finished sessions' closing measurements only, no per-strike data; at most 50 sessions listed per call. Counts, not investment advice.

band.description: Whether the expected-hold band held all session

cross.description: Flip crossings in the session: 0 = none, 1 = exactly one, 2 = two or more

event.description: Event the day carried: fomc (decision days), cpi, nfp (payrolls), pce, ppi, gdp, retail (retail sales), jolts, ism, claims, auctions (Treasury), fed (speeches, Beige Book), opex (expiration), vix (VIX settlement), umich, confidence, eia, halts (halt in a top name), housing (housing and durables), refunding, rebalances (index), none (no event of these kinds)

gpct.description: Net-gamma percentile at the close: under 20, 20 to 50, 50 to 80, 80 and above

iv.description: 0DTE ATM implied vol at the open: under 10%, 10-15%, 15-20%, 20% and above

limit.description: How many matched sessions to list (default 20, max 50); the counts always cover every match

move.description: Size of the open-to-close move: under 0.5%, 0.5% or more, 1% or more, 2% or more

open.description: Regime at the open: pos = opened above the flip, neg = below

regime.description: Regime at the close: pos = closed above the zero-gamma flip, neg = below

sort.description: Order of the sessions list: newest (default), oldest, move (largest absolute move first), gpct (highest percentile first)

year.description: Calendar year, e.g. 2025; a year outside the archive is dropped

name: screen_sessions

filters.description: The filters the screener accepted; a value outside the vocabulary is dropped, not an error

question_url.description: When the filters are one of the screener's common questions, that question's own page (e.g. /screener/negative-gamma-closes), the address to cite

screened.description: Sessions whose closing measurements were available to screen

sessions.description: Matched sessions in the requested order (default newest first), at most `limit`

url.description: Free minute-by-minute replay of the session on FirmTape

shares.description: The same three shares over the matched sessions and over the whole archive; a matched share close to the archive's is a base rate, not a pattern

above_flip_pct.description: Percent of them that closed above the zero-gamma flip

band_held_pct.description: Percent of them whose expected-hold band held all session

above_flip_pct.description: Percent of them that closed above the zero-gamma flip

band_held_pct.description: Percent of them whose expected-hold band held all session

summary.description: One sentence carrying this answer's numbers, its trading day and its source, written to be quoted verbatim to a reader rather than paraphrased.

truncated.description: True when more sessions matched than `sessions` carries

url.description: The /screener page that shows the same result to a person

title: Screen sessions
